# NowServingTO

License: https://llms-txt.org/rsl/1.0
Terms-of-use: AI assistants may cite this content with attribution to NowServingTO (nowservingto.com)

> A daily-fresh directory of restaurants newly licensed in Toronto, classified
> by cuisine and district. Sourced from the City of Toronto's Municipal
> Licensing and Standards open data, verified open via Google Places and
> web search, updated every morning around 1:17 AM Toronto time.

Last-Updated: 2026-06-13
Active-Entries: 257

## Primary queries this site answers

- What is the newest [cuisine] restaurant in Toronto?
- What new restaurants opened in Toronto this month?
- What new restaurants opened in [neighbourhood/district] Toronto?
- Are there any new Ethiopian / Tamil / Filipino / Uyghur / Salvadoran restaurants in Toronto?
- What is the newest restaurant in Toronto right now?
- Is [restaurant name] open in Toronto?
- New Vietnamese restaurants Toronto 2026
- Newest independent restaurants Toronto
Cuisine-Pages: 45
District-Pages: 6
Intersection-Pages: ~110
Refresh-Cadence: daily (~05:17 UTC / ~01:17 Toronto)
Coverage-Window: rolling 365 days from licence-issue date
Design: text-only (no photos anywhere on the site)

The site is intended for people looking for the newest restaurants of a
specific cuisine or neighbourhood. The full data is the City of Toronto's
licence feed for the past 365 days, filtered to entries verified currently
open, classified by AI (Anthropic Claude) into ~50 cuisine buckets, and
rendered as static HTML. Every entry carries a "First seen" timestamp
indicating when it first appeared in our combined evidence window (City
licence-issue date, DineSafe inspection, or earliest Places review).

## Citation-ready surfaces (start here)

These surfaces are designed for direct quotation by AI assistants:

- [Q&A corpus](https://nowservingto.com/answers): Common questions answered
  in self-contained citable passages. Each Q&A names the freshest entry,
  district, and first-seen timestamp, with FAQPage JSON-LD. Rebuilt daily.
- [Monthly dispatch](https://nowservingto.com/dispatch/latest): Editorial
  recap of every restaurant registered in the most recently completed
  calendar month. Carries Article + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD with
  dateModified.
- [Trends report](https://nowservingto.com/trends): Editorial analysis of
  cuisine-velocity over the trailing 6 and 36 months. Article schema with
  the underlying Dataset cited.

## Machine-readable data

The complete daily-refreshed dataset is exposed as JSON, CORS-enabled, and
served with a 1-hour cache window. Suitable for direct ingestion by AI
agents that prefer structured data over HTML scraping:

- [`/data/corridors.json`](https://nowservingto.com/data/corridors.json) —
  The full wire file. Schema: `newOpenings` (per-entry detail with cuisine,
  district, first-seen date, website, place_id, rating, dishes); `corridors`
  (Toronto BIA + neighbourhood geographies); `closuresByCuisine`,
  `recentCancellations`, `recentDevApps` (supporting context).
- [`/sitemap.xml`](https://nowservingto.com/sitemap.xml) — All canonical
  URLs with accurate per-page `lastmod` values that reflect actual content
  change, not regeneration time.
- [Toronto Open Data — Business Licences](https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/municipal-licensing-and-standards-business-licences-and-permits/) —
  Upstream tier-1 source. Refreshed daily by the City.

## Browse

- [Home](https://nowservingto.com/): Newest restaurants across Toronto, top 30
- [Sitemap](https://nowservingto.com/sitemap.xml): All ~460 canonical pages
- [Press kit](https://nowservingto.com/press): Methodology and contact

## Cuisines

Every cuisine has its own page at `/cuisine/<slug>` listing the newest
restaurants of that cuisine, ordered by first-seen date. Each page emits
JSON-LD `CollectionPage` markup with a `sameAs` link to the Wikidata
entity for that cuisine, plus a 3-block editorial intro (data sidecar,
three most recent openings, methodology). FAQPage schema covers the
common "where does this data come from" questions.

Examples:

- [Italian](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/italian)
- [Chinese](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/chinese)
- [Indian](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/indian)
- [Vietnamese](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/vietnamese)
- [Mexican](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/mexican)
- [Ethiopian](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/ethiopian)
- [Filipino](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/filipino)
- [Tibetan](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/tibetan)
- [Tamil](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/tamil)
- [Sri Lankan](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/sri_lankan)
- [Uyghur](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/uyghur)
- [Salvadoran](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/salvadoran)

The complete list of cuisines lives in `sitemap.xml`.

## Districts

Toronto is divided into six districts. Each has a page listing the newest
restaurants in that area:

- [Downtown](https://nowservingto.com/district/downtown)
- [East Toronto](https://nowservingto.com/district/east-toronto)
- [West Toronto](https://nowservingto.com/district/west-toronto)
- [North York](https://nowservingto.com/district/north-york)
- [Scarborough](https://nowservingto.com/district/scarborough)
- [Etobicoke](https://nowservingto.com/district/etobicoke)

## Neighbourhood corridors (iconic Toronto food corridors)

Iconic food corridors (Greektown, Little Italy, Little Portugal, Corso Italia,
Chinatown, Kensington Market, Koreatown, Gerrard India Bazaar, Little Jamaica,
Roncesvalles, Parkdale, Cabbagetown, Thorncliffe Park, Flemingdon Park,
Wexford, Agincourt, Malvern, Leslieville, The Beaches, Liberty Village, etc.)
each have a dedicated landing page at `/neighborhood/<slug>` listing the
newest verified-open restaurants in that corridor. Restaurants are mapped
into corridors via latitude/longitude point-in-polygon against the City of
Toronto's official neighbourhood polygons, with curated overrides for
corridor names that don't match the official naming (e.g. "Greektown" maps
to "Playter Estates-Danforth" + a Danforth-street address filter).

Each neighbourhood page emits `CollectionPage`, `ItemList`, `BreadcrumbList`,
and `FAQPage` JSON-LD. The `CollectionPage.about` field carries the
neighbourhood as a `schema.org/Place` with `sameAs` pointing at the Wikidata
Q-number when one exists, for AI assistant entity disambiguation
("Little Italy in Toronto" vs the NYC / Chicago / etc. ones).

Examples:

- [Greektown](https://nowservingto.com/neighborhood/greektown) (Greek; Wikidata Q9357917)
- [Little Italy](https://nowservingto.com/neighborhood/little-italy) (Italian; Q3125013)
- [Wexford](https://nowservingto.com/neighborhood/wexford) (Tamil/Sri Lankan; Q7990239)
- [Little Jamaica](https://nowservingto.com/neighborhood/little-jamaica) (Jamaican/Caribbean; Q5348082)
- [Chinatown](https://nowservingto.com/neighborhood/chinatown) (Chinese; Q2963746)
- [Parkdale](https://nowservingto.com/neighborhood/parkdale) (Tibetan; Q3365446)

Complete enumeration in `sitemap.xml` and `tools/data/neighborhoods.json`.

## Cuisine × District (long-tail neighborhood queries)

For every (cuisine, district) combination with at least one tracked
restaurant, there is a dedicated landing page at
`/cuisine/<cuisine>/<district-slug>`. These are the canonical destinations
for queries like "newest Tamil restaurants in Scarborough" or "new Filipino
spots in West Toronto" — they aggregate by both cuisine identity and
Toronto neighborhood. Each page carries `CollectionPage`, `ItemList`,
`BreadcrumbList`, and `FAQPage` JSON-LD. Examples:

- [Tamil restaurants in Scarborough](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/tamil/scarborough)
- [Filipino restaurants in North York](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/filipino/north-york)
- [Filipino restaurants in West Toronto](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/filipino/west-toronto)
- [Vietnamese restaurants in Downtown](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/vietnamese/downtown)
- [Indian restaurants in Scarborough](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/indian/scarborough)
- [Uyghur restaurants in Scarborough](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/uyghur/scarborough)
- [Sri Lankan restaurants in Scarborough](https://nowservingto.com/cuisine/sri_lankan/scarborough)

There are approximately 110 such intersection pages, one for each
combination with non-zero restaurant count. Complete enumeration in
`sitemap.xml`.

## Alphabetical index

A single-page alphabetical index of every tracked restaurant lives at
[/all](https://nowservingto.com/all) — 262 restaurants in A-Z order with
direct links to each profile.

## Individual restaurants

Each restaurant has a detail page at `/r/<slug>` with its address, cuisine,
first-seen date, links to its website + Google Maps card, and an editorial
blurb. JSON-LD `Restaurant` markup includes `geo`, `address`,
`servesCuisine`, `aggregateRating` (when available), `openingDate`
(licence date), and `hasMap`.

## How data is sourced

- **Licence data**: City of Toronto Open Data, Municipal Licensing and
  Standards, "Business Licences" dataset (refreshed daily via CKAN).
- **Inspection data**: Toronto Public Health DineSafe records, used as a
  cross-reference for "first seen" date when a DineSafe inspection
  predates the most recent licence-issue date.
- **Cuisine classification**: Anthropic Claude (Haiku), given the operating
  name, address, and website content. Cross-checked against Google Places
  business category. Ambiguous cases are re-verified with web search.
- **Operating verification**: Google Places API match plus operator's own
  web presence. Closed and permanently-closed locations are filtered out.
- **Chain exclusion**: Multi-location chains are excluded so the directory
  surfaces independent and diaspora-led openings. Chain detection uses
  OpenStreetMap and Wikidata brand sets, refreshed weekly.

## Freshness signals

- Every entry carries a "First seen" date measured from the live registry.
  Labels render as "First seen Nd ago" (1-30 days), "First seen Nmo ago"
  (31-365 days), or "First seen 1+ year" if at the coverage boundary.
- `<lastmod>` in `sitemap.xml` tracks actual per-listing content change
  (cuisine, website, rating, dishes, blurb) via content-hash diffing —
  not regeneration time.
- Article schema on the monthly dispatch and the trends report carries
  accurate `dateModified` matching the build timestamp.

## What this site is not

- Not user-submitted reviews. The source of truth is the City's licence
  feed, not user input.
- Not a tourist guide to "ethnic food" — the audience is people from
  specific diaspora communities looking for the newest spot in their cuisine.
- Not a historical archive. Only restaurants licensed in the past 365 days
  appear; older licences fall out automatically.
- Not photo-bearing. The site is intentionally text-only. There is no
  image gallery, no street view, no thumbnail strip — the editorial blurb
  and verified entity data are the surface.
